in_marathi.name: Kana
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of the Kinnara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kana हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kana is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kinnari', which refers to a celestial being or 'Apsara' in Hindu mythology. The Kinnari is a beautiful and graceful creature, often depicted as a bird with the lower body of a woman. Kana signifies the inner beauty and grace that a woman embodies. It is a name that signifies motherhood, nurturing, and the ability to create and sustain life.
